item.onion_onion.motley_grill.descriptio: A serving of Motley Grill. Place the Motley Grill and use a Bowl on it to take a serving.
block.onion_onion.motley_grill_block.des: A layered onion feast that flares up when set over a heat source. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
